editorial.title: Made for days you remember.
editorial.body: We craft equipment that disappears beneath you, leaving only wind, water, and momentum. Tested rigorously against the Atlantic chop and Mediterranean thermals to deliver uncompromised feel.

shipping.title: Complimentary EU Shipping
shipping.body: Orders over €150 delivered via carbon-neutral transit within 2–4 business days.

returns.title: 30-Day Ocean Guarantee
returns.body: Rig it, ride it on the open water. Complete exchange or full return if it doesn’t fit your style.

warranty.title: 2-Year Craftsmanship Warranty
warranty.body: Direct European workshop support and dedicated canopy repair service for extended lifespan.

advice.title: Expert Kite Advisory
advice.body: Chat with our dedicated riders in Tarifa to dial in your kite size and mast setup.

specs.title: Technical Specifications
specs.pledgeBody: Every DRFT kite bag is constructed from 100% recycled ocean-bound PET ripstop. When your kite reaches the end of its flight life, return it for complimentary recycling in exchange for €150 fleet credit.

related.title: Complete Your Setup
related.intro: Precision gear calibrated by our test riders to unlock the full aerodynamic potential of the {name}.

tarifa.title:
Defy gravity.
Pure flight.
tarifa.body: Ultra-modulus carbon airframes and precision freeride kites engineered for unmatched lift, raw acceleration, and effortless control.

atlantic.title:
Built for the
open Atlantic.
atlantic.body: Reinforced leading edges and Teijin Quad-Tex canopies, proven in cold, heavy swell from Brittany to the Algarve.

lagoon.title:
Effortless lift.
Endless sessions.
lagoon.body: Sheet-and-go power, sub-3s relaunch and a wind range that keeps you riding from the first breeze to the last light.

fleet.title: The 2025 Fleet
fleet.intro: Engineered for pure freeride flight, crisp steering, and effortless relaunch in all wind conditions.

philosophy.quote: “We craft equipment that disappears beneath you, leaving only wind, water, and momentum.”

innovation.label: 01 / Innovation
innovation.title: Refined Hydrodynamics
innovation.body: Minimal drag airframes and calibrated foil profiles tested across cold northern waters to ensure maximum glide in marginal knots.

sensation.label: 02 / Sensation
sensation.title: Direct Tactile Feedback
sensation.body: Pulleyless bridle systems and monocoque carbon bars engineered for immediate mechanical response and zero line lag.

craft.label: 03 / Craft
craft.title: European Atelier Rigging
craft.body: Every kite, foil, and control bar is individually hand-inspected and pre-flight tensioned before final dispatch to riders.

fieldNotes.title: The North Sea Protocol
fieldNotes.body: Tested from Scheveningen to Nazaré. Built to withstand punishing salt encrustation, shifting sand bars, and sustained 35-knot gale gusts.

disciplines.title: Disciplines & Systems
disciplines.intro: Complete aerodynamic and hydrodynamic packages configured for high-speed progression.

kites.label: 01 / Aerodynamics
kites.title: Kites & Airframes
kites.body: Freeride, Big Air, and lightwind canopy setups engineered for stable loft.

foils.label: 02 / Hydrodynamics
foils.title: Foil Boards & Wings
foils.body: Carbon modular foils and compact carving boards tuned for friction-free flight.

control.label: 03 / Transmission
control.title: TwinTips & Control
control.body: Precision carbon twin tips and Sentry Pro ISO-certified bar systems.

spotlight.body: Designed for effortless progression. The third generation Aero redefines wind range with an ultra-rigid airframe that absorbs gusts without unsettling your stance.

frame.title: Tri-Strut Low-Profile Frame
frame.body: Reduces airframe drag by 14% for quicker climbing through the wind window.

relaunch.title: Sub-3s Relaunch Dynamics
relaunch.body: Curved wingtips roll the kite onto the tip instantly upon bar release.

pressure.title: -18% Bar Pressure Fatigue
pressure.body: Direct pulleys eliminate friction so you feel every knot of clean power.

brittany.title: The Perfect Wind Window: 48 Hours in Western Brittany
brittany.excerpt: Chasing a rapid low-pressure system across the Finistère coastline with team riders Leo and Marion.

tuning.title: Hydrofoil Tuning: Finding Equilibrium in Variable Chop
tuning.excerpt: Stabilizer angle shimming, mast placement calibration, and pitch balance adjustments for rolling swell.

circularity.title: Circularity in Watersports: Recycling Canopy Dacron
circularity.excerpt: How our European repair workshop partners convert decommissioned wings into technical travel luggage.

newsletter.title: Stay on the pulse of the wind.
newsletter.body: Seasonal fleet releases, Atlantic swell forecasts, atelier telemetry, and firsthand rider field notes delivered directly from our test stations in Tarifa and Brittany.
newsletter.consent: By registering, you agree to our <link>Privacy Policy</link>. We safeguard your rider telemetry.
